// Regenerates default_profile_golden.json. Not part of the build: copy it as
// internal/life/golden_gen_test.go into a checkout of the engine before
// warrior profiles existed (git worktree add --detach /tmp/golden 63c742e1),
// paste in the current fightScenarios and bossScenarios if they changed, then
//
//	GOLDEN_OUT=/tmp/out.json go test ./internal/life -run TestWriteGolden
//
// and copy /tmp/out.json over the golden. The digests must come from the old
// engine: a golden made by the current one proves nothing.
package life

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"testing"

	"github.com/go-gl/mathgl/mgl32"
	"github.com/sandertv/gophertunnel/minecraft/protocol"
	"github.com/sandertv/gophertunnel/minecraft/protocol/packet"
)

var fightScenarios = map[string]func(r *rig){
	"ranger kiting a walking zombie": func(r *rig) {
		r.give(0, 303, 1)
		r.give(1, 361, 1)
		r.give(20, 362, 32)
		z := mgl32.Vec3{26.5, 1, 20.5}
		r.spawn(50, "minecraft:zombie", z)
		for i := 0; i < 120; i++ {
			z = z.Sub(mgl32.Vec3{0.1, 0, 0})
			r.moveTo(50, z)
			r.step()
		}
	},
	"striker on a zombie under a skeleton's line, arrows and blows": func(r *rig) {
		r.setSquad(r.t, &fakeSquad{leaderID: "lead", leader: mgl32.Vec3{12.5, 1, 20.5}, leaderOK: true})
		r.give(0, 303, 1)
		r.give(2, 360, 1)
		r.spawn(50, "minecraft:zombie", mgl32.Vec3{22.5, 1, 20.5})
		r.spawn(51, "minecraft:skeleton", mgl32.Vec3{28.5, 1, 20.5})
		r.spawn(70, "minecraft:arrow", mgl32.Vec3{30, 30, 30})
		var arrow mgl32.Vec3
		for i := 0; i < 160; i++ {
			if i%60 == 0 {
				r.hurt()
			}
			// An arrow loosed at the unit every second or so, from far
			// enough out that how near counts as near decides when the
			// shield meets it.
			if i%25 == 0 {
				arrow = r.feet().Add(mgl32.Vec3{7, 1, 0})
			}
			arrow = arrow.Sub(mgl32.Vec3{0.5, 0, 0})
			r.moveTo(70, arrow)
			r.step()
		}
	},
	"a zombie walking in from beyond focus range": func(r *rig) {
		r.give(0, 303, 1)
		z := mgl32.Vec3{36.5, 1, 20.5}
		r.spawn(50, "minecraft:zombie", z)
		for i := 0; i < 80; i++ {
			z = z.Sub(mgl32.Vec3{0.05, 0, 0})
			r.moveTo(50, z)
			r.step()
		}
	},
	"hurt with a zombie just out of arm's reach": func(r *rig) {
		r.give(0, 303, 1)
		r.give(3, 363, 2)
		r.setHealth(10)
		r.spawn(50, "minecraft:zombie", mgl32.Vec3{24, 1, 20.5})
		r.run(30)
	},
	"hurt striker pressed, then eating, then regrouping": func(r *rig) {
		squad := &fakeSquad{leaderID: "lead", leader: mgl32.Vec3{10.5, 1, 20.5}, leaderOK: true}
		r.setSquad(r.t, squad)
		r.give(0, 303, 1)
		r.give(3, 363, 2)
		r.setHealth(10)
		r.spawn(50, "minecraft:zombie", mgl32.Vec3{22.5, 1, 20.5})
		for i := 0; i < 80; i++ {
			r.step()
			r.moveTo(50, r.feet().Add(mgl32.Vec3{1.2, 0, 0}))
		}
		squad.order = Order{Kind: OrderRegroup}
		r.moveTo(50, mgl32.Vec3{30.5, 1, 30.5})
		r.run(60)
	},
}

var bossScenarios = map[string]struct {
	role string
	from float32
	run  func(*rig, *fakeRoster)
}{
	"ranger shooting from its band": {role: "ranger", from: 24, run: func(r *rig, _ *fakeRoster) { r.run(130) }},
	"hurt striker eating off the boss": {role: "striker", from: 10, run: func(r *rig, _ *fakeRoster) {
		r.give(3, 363, 2)
		r.setHealth(16)
		r.run(60)
	}},
	"striker regrouping to the start": {role: "striker", from: 10, run: func(r *rig, squad *fakeRoster) {
		squad.down, squad.start, squad.startOK = 2, mgl32.Vec3{10.5, 1, 40.5}, true
		r.run(250)
	}},
	"vanguard holding the melee": {role: "vanguard", from: 2, run: func(r *rig, _ *fakeRoster) { r.run(100) }},
}

func replay(t *testing.T, role string, scenario func(*rig), set func(*Life)) []any {
	t.Helper()
	r := newWarrior(t, role, start)
	if set != nil {
		set(r.l)
	}
	scenario(r)
	got := make([]any, len(r.out.got))
	for i, pk := range r.out.got {
		got[i] = pk
	}
	return got
}

// goldenReplayBoss is replayBoss without a profile, which the old engine lacks.
func goldenReplayBoss(t *testing.T, name string) []any {
	t.Helper()
	sc := bossScenarios[name]
	r, squad := newBossWarrior(t, sc.role, arena.Sub(mgl32.Vec3{sc.from, 0, 0}))
	sc.run(r, squad)
	got := make([]any, len(r.out.got))
	for i, pk := range r.out.got {
		got[i] = pk
	}
	return got
}

func packetDigest(t *testing.T, pks []any) string {
	t.Helper()
	h := sha256.New()
	for _, p := range pks {
		pk := p.(packet.Packet)
		var buf bytes.Buffer
		pk.Marshal(protocol.NewWriter(&buf, 0))
		h.Write([]byte{byte(pk.ID())})
		h.Write(buf.Bytes())
		h.Write([]byte{0xff})
	}
	return hex.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil))
}

func TestWriteGolden(t *testing.T) {
	out := map[string]string{}
	var names []string
	for n := range fightScenarios {
		names = append(names, n)
	}
	sort.Strings(names)
	for _, n := range names {
		for _, role := range []string{"vanguard", "striker", "ranger"} {
			out["fight/"+n+"/"+role] = packetDigest(t, replay(t, role, fightScenarios[n], nil))
		}
	}
	for n := range bossScenarios {
		out["boss/"+n] = packetDigest(t, goldenReplayBoss(t, n))
	}
	b, _ := json.MarshalIndent(out, "", "  ")
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("GOLDEN_OUT"), append(b, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
